## Source-gate relevance

The critical source fragment already matches virtual/physical W prefixes:

- `out/prepared-source-bypass-20261008/compact_pretl_owner_fragment.sv:87-111` requires `vw_q > vr_q && pw_q > pr_q`, owner/sequence match, and contiguous prepared virtual/physical W prefixes.
- Lines `98-99` explicitly say: count only matching prepared virtual and physical W prefixes; never infer next physical W owner from the virtual FIFO alone.
- Lines `112-131` then check parent offset/returned progress and cap capacity.

Therefore I did not use an imaginary unprepared-destination counterexample. The C3 `2987` opposite-flow `vaw` rows are not used as such a counterexample; they are only mirrored V/A virtual AWs in the same window.

## What the records cannot prove

- Cannot prove internal `w_fifo_push`, first AW VALID, W-beat issuance, W-completion, or queue occupancy. `vaw` is handshake-only.
- Cannot prove “unfinished data.” The supplied JSON has no W-channel rows.
- Cannot prove source is actually not fully read internally. Absence of `var`/`par` rows before a cycle in this address-event snapshot is only absence in the snapshot.
- Cannot distinguish an already-existing child obligation from a later source child or raw-parent continuation.
- Cannot prove actual freeze/deadlock or a new mechanism.
- Cannot resolve whether the A `adst id4` flow’s source is `asrc id4`, `asrc id37`, or `asrc id36` from these address rows alone.
